_README: Contestable registry behind the claim-relative motive tier. Same status as tier_map.json:
it is published so a reader can dispute it.
publisher_owner  publisher domain -> the organisation that owns it.
entity_domains   an entity -> domains it publishes on. Used to spot an article that
cites only the subject's own site.
stakes           owner -> entities it holds a financial stake in. A publisher owned by a
stakeholder is tier 4 on claims about that entity.
aliases          entity -> other surface forms used in article prose.
⛔ EMPTY IS CORRECT WHERE IT IS EMPTY. An unlisted publisher keeps its source-type tier
and is marked tier_basis 'source-type'. Never fill an entry from recollection: every
ownership and stake claim rendered on the board must trace to a filing or company
statement first (the 25b rule). 'stakes' is deliberately blank pending that sourcing.
